scope: Planned commercial video campaign-direction specifications only. Each case is a fixture, not an evaluated model response, host run, generation, campaign result or behavior PASS. Fixtures execute no tools.

cases.user_request: Mam zatwierdzone opakowanie nowego miodu i dokładne hasło „Łyżka lata”. Zaproponuj kampanię video na Instagram Reels, stronę produktu i poziomy ekran na targach. Nie zmieniaj copy.
checks: Binds approved package and exact phrase as locked inputs
Creates distinct communication jobs for Reel, product-page video and event screen
Does not copy one aspect/layout or pacing 1:1 across the three contexts
Runs current placement research for exact named surfaces and separates requirements from recommendations
Uses no unsupplied origin, health, quality or performance claim
Returns a campaign-level direction and bounded downstream handoff, not shot cards or a generator prompt

cases.user_request: Zrób reklamę, która stanie się viralem. Mój produkt jest świetny. Wymyśl coś mocnego.
checks: Does not promise or imply viral reach or sales performance
Does not invent product features, audience pain or proof
Asks one concise question about product truth or the communication job, or clearly labels a provisional hypothesis
Uses the hard gate as REWORK or BLOCKED if the missing truth is essential
Does not deliver a polished final direction while a material gate failure remains

cases.user_request: Mam zatwierdzone ujęcie produktu. Napisz tylko gotowy prompt do Seedance dla tego jednego ujęcia.
checks: Routes directly to video-prompt-architect for a single generator prompt
Does not open a campaign-direction brainstorm or manufacture a multi-asset plan
The receiving owner performs current model and operation research before syntax-specific prompt claims

cases.user_request: Rozpisz tę zatwierdzoną reklamę na beaty, czas i karty ujęć. Nie wymyślaj nowej koncepcji.
checks: Routes time-based beat map and shot-card authoring to storyboard-sequence-architect
Preserves the approved commercial direction as upstream input
Does not duplicate or rewrite the direction owner output

cases.user_request: Potrzebuję statycznego plakatu dla tej kampanii. Nie ma być żadnej animacji ani filmu.
checks: Routes the static-only deliverable to commercial-visual-campaign-director
Does not invent motion or video assets
Carries a shared campaign fact only if it was actually supplied and relevant

cases.user_request: Sprawdź aktualne limity i safe zones dla konkretnej konfiguracji TikTok Auction In-Feed Non-Spark i przygotuj zwięzłą rekomendację kampanijną.
checks: Searches current official documentation for the exact placement and ad workflow
Separates current technical requirements from creative recommendations and internal validator behavior
Cites source, access date, exact scope and any uncertainty
Does not turn placement limits into an optimal-duration claim or universal TikTok rule

cases.user_request: Bez internetu. Daj prowizoryczny kierunek reklamy, ale nie twierdź nic o aktualnych wymaganiach platformy.
checks: Respects explicit prohibition on web search
Does not claim current platform rules or up-to-date safe zones
Labels mutable placement assumptions as unverified
Can still provide a neutral, truth-bounded direction if the brief supports one

cases.user_request: W trybie rozbudowanym chcę trzy różne pomysły na reklamę nowego napoju. Fakty: ma naturalnie mętny wygląd; nie mamy badań ani zatwierdzonych claimów. Możesz wykorzystać moją obserwację, że klienci pytają, czy to wada.
checks: Builds three materially distinct idea mechanisms, not palette-only variations
Treats the customer-question statement as user-supplied context, not population-level research
Does not claim that cloudiness proves quality or benefit
Gives each concept a different motion action/proof logic and states its tradeoff
Marks all copy as proposed unless approved

cases.user_request: Zrób reklamę jak każdy premium brand: szybki dronowy orbit, makro, slow motion, głośny drop i szybkie cięcia. Produkt ma być najważniejszy.
checks: Does not accept an adjective/effect list as a complete idea
Identifies the missing product truth or asks one focused question
Explains the specific anti-generic failure and sets REWORK or BLOCKED
